data.title: Downer EDI discloses director Annette Carey’s exit and final interests
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Downer EDI Limited ( (AU:DOW) ).

Downer EDI Limited has announced that director Annette Carey ceased to be a director of the company on 14 September 2026, with her previous interests last notified on 9 March 2026. The filing confirms she holds a beneficial interest in 10,000 ordinary shares via Sandose Pty Ltd as trustee for the Ian Martindale Superannuation Fund, and reports no additional relevant interests or contracts, indicating a straightforward board departure with limited implications for the company’s capital structure.

This change forms part of the company’s continuous disclosure obligations to the ASX, ensuring transparency around director-level shareholdings at the time of her exit. While the notice does not detail reasons for her departure or any succession plans, it clarifies there are no related contractual interests, suggesting no immediate governance or financial complications arising from this board change.

data.title: Kona BidCo Lifts Stake in Zalaris to Nearly 88% of Voting Rights
data.description:

Kona BidCo AS has increased its ownership in Zalaris ASA by acquiring 55 additional shares at NOK 100 per share through market purchases. Following this transaction, Kona BidCo AS now holds 19,384,977 shares, representing about 87.57% of Zalaris’s issued share capital and voting rights.

Adjusted for Zalaris’s own shareholdings, Kona BidCo’s stake rises to approximately 88.80%, consolidating control over the HR and payroll services provider. As Kona BidCo is closely associated with board chair Fredrik Gyllenhammar Raaum, the move underscores concentrated ownership and may influence governance dynamics and strategic direction for remaining minority shareholders.

data.title: Arandu Investimentos Updates Share Valuation Ahead of Tender Offer
data.description:
REAG Investimentos SA ( (BR:ARND3) ) has issued an announcement.

Arandu Investimentos S.A. reported that its controlling shareholder, Arandu Partners Holding S.A., has submitted a revised appraisal report as part of the registration process for a public tender offer to acquire all outstanding common shares, excluding those already held by the controlling shareholder or in treasury. The updated valuation, prepared using a discounted cash flow methodology, increased the indicated value of the company’s shares from R$0.60 to R$0.66, while the tender offer price remains set at R$0.67 per share, subject to pro rata adjustment by changes in the SELIC rate until the auction settlement, signaling a modest premium to appraised value and clarifying terms for minority shareholders evaluating the offer.

The company has made the new appraisal report available on its investor relations website and will also disclose it through CVM and B3 platforms to enhance transparency for investors. By updating the market on these changes and reaffirming that the communication is informational rather than a recommendation, Arandu Investimentos underscores its compliance with Brazilian securities regulation and provides stakeholders with clearer parameters for assessing the financial attractiveness and timing implications of the proposed tender offer.

data.title: Westwater Updates Battery-Grade Graphite Strategy and Progress
data.description:
Westwater Resources ( (WWR) ) has provided an announcement.

On September 14, 2026, Westwater Resources’ Executive Chairman Terence Cryan presented the company’s updated business plan at the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference, coinciding with the posting of an investor presentation on its website. The materials highlighted Westwater’s progress on its Kellyton Graphite Plant, where more than half of the planned $245 million capital cost has been invested and an EXIM loan approved, as well as its broader mine-to-market graphite strategy centered on U.S. battery demand.

The update underscored that Phase 1 of the Kellyton facility is designed to provide 12,500 mtpa of battery-grade natural graphite, with Phase 2 expected to lift capacity to 50,000 mtpa, supported by ongoing customer qualification and offtake discussions. By advancing a strategically located, vertically integrated graphite operation at a time when the U.S. imports all battery-grade natural graphite and relies heavily on Chinese supply, the company is seeking to strengthen its industry positioning and appeal to stakeholders focused on domestic, secure battery-materials sourcing.

data.title: TransDigm Prices Larger 2035 Senior Secured Notes Offering
data.description:
TransDigm Group Incorporated Shs Unsponsored Brazilian Depositary Receipt Repr 0.02 Sh ( (BR:T1DG34) ) has provided an announcement.

On September 14, 2026, TransDigm Group announced that its subsidiary TransDigm Inc. had priced a $3,000 million offering of 6.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2035, increased from an initially planned $2,500 million. The notes, issued at par and guaranteed by TransDigm Group and select subsidiaries, are being privately placed under Rule 144A and Regulation S, with closing expected on September 28, 2026, subject to customary conditions.

TransDigm Group plans to use the net proceeds to repurchase all of TransDigm Inc.’s outstanding 6.75% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 through a concurrent tender offer launched on September 14, 2026, and for general corporate purposes. The transaction effectively extends the company’s debt maturity profile and may support its ongoing financial flexibility, although the notes will remain restricted to qualified institutional buyers and certain non U.S. investors under securities law exemptions.

data.title: TransAlta Ordered to Keep Centralia Unit 2 Available for 90 More Days
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from TransAlta ( (TSE:TA) ).

On September 14, 2026, TransAlta said its U.S. subsidiary TransAlta Centralia Generation LLC received an order from the Department of Energy covering its Centralia Unit 2 in Washington state. The order mandates the coal-fired unit remain available for operation for 90 days, until December 12, 2026, extending its availability beyond previously anticipated timelines.

Once the order takes effect, TransAlta intends to comply and coordinate with the Department of Energy and Washington state authorities regarding the unit’s status. The move underscores the continuing role of legacy thermal generation in grid reliability, with potential implications for regional power supply and TransAlta’s short-term operational planning at Centralia.
